items.distractor_fact: Uy termometri o'sha payt {D}°C haroratni ko'rsatdi.
items.gloss_en: A household thermometer showed a temperature of {D}°C at that moment.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different measuring instrument (a household thermometer), not a place-based station in a neighboring district as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Savdo panelidagi indeks shartnomasi o'sha kuni {D} dollardan yopildi.
items.gloss_en: An index contract on the trading panel closed that day at {D} dollars.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different financial instrument (an index contract), not another company's stock as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Portdagi suv o'lchagich asbobi o'sha kuni sathni {D} santimetr deb ko'rsatdi.
items.gloss_en: The water-gauge instrument at the port that day showed the level as {D} centimetres.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different measuring instrument (a port's water gauge), not a neighboring lake as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Yaqin atrofdagi radiolokatsiya minorasi {D} metr balandlikda joylashgan.
items.gloss_en: A nearby radar tower is located at an altitude of {D} metres.
items.entity_note: belongs to a fixed instrument/structure (a nearby radar tower), not another aircraft as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Dorixonadan yuborilgan yetkazib berish posilkasi {D} kilogramm tortdi.
items.gloss_en: A delivery package sent from the pharmacy weighed {D} kilograms.
items.entity_note: belongs to an inanimate object (a delivery package), not another patient as in the first sentence

items.gloss_en: The road safety service set the speed limit on this road at {D} km/h.
items.entity_note: belongs to an organisation (the road safety service's posted limit), not another car as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Boshqa filialdagi zaxira mablag' {D} dollarni tashkil etdi.
items.gloss_en: The reserve fund at a different branch came to {D} dollars.
items.entity_note: belongs to an organisation (a different bank branch's reserve fund), not another customer as in the first sentence

items.gloss_en: The shop owner's personal expense that month came to {D} dollars.
items.entity_note: belongs to a person (the shop owner's personal expense), not another department as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Terma jamoaning bir futbolchisi boshqa bir uchrashuvda {D} ta gol urdi.
items.gloss_en: A player of the national team scored {D} goals in a different match.
items.entity_note: belongs to a person (an individual footballer's tally in a different match), not another team as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Golf simulyatorida o'ynagan foydalanuvchi shu kuni {D} ta zarba bilan yakunladi.
items.gloss_en: A user playing on a golf simulator finished that day with {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different instrument (a golf simulator, whose own par is not stated), not a different golfer on a different real course as in the first sentence

items.gloss_en: A supervising staff member started their shift that day at minute {D} after midnight.
items.entity_note: belongs to a person (a staff member's shift start, unrelated to any train timetable), not another train on a different route as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Ikkinchi devizionda o'ynagan bir futbolchi shu kuni {D} ta gol urdi.
items.gloss_en: A footballer playing in the second division scored {D} goals that day.
items.entity_note: belongs to a person (an individual player in a different division), not a third team in a different match as in the first sentence
